Steps[]

  1. Go look for inspiration
  2. Find a goof viewpoint to design your composition
  3. Talk to the strange white cat
  4. Continue onward
  5. Showcase Tacet Discords in your painting
  6. Return to speak with your manager
  7. Paint?
  8. Paint...?
  9. Resist the nightmares
  10. Stop the nightmares from corrupting Zhezhi
  11. Defeat the nightmares
  12. Stop the nightmares from corrupting Zhezhi
  13. Confront the nightmares
  14. Activate Dream Link and defeat the nightmares together
  15. Defeat the nightmares
  16. Leave the Somnoire
  17. (Optional) Talk to Zhezhi

Dialogue[]

(Enter the gateway)
You feel you body grow heavy, as if you're sinking beneath the water, and finally find yourself in an unfamiliar dream.
Art Manager: Master Zhezhi, have you made any plans for your next painting?
Ah, n-not yet.
Art Manager: If you don't paint, you don't earn! You don't wanna end up broke, do ya?
Art Manager: What about painting... what was it called? Ah, Winter's Serenade in Bloom
I've already painted that one...
I-I want to try something different.
Art Manager: So what? Your clients' preferences are what matter most.
Art Manager: Don't worry, Master Zhezhi! I handpicked you clients and know them like the back of my hand.
Art Manager: That painting was outstandingly popular, I would know.
Art Manager: Trust me. This will be another best-seller!
I-I need to consider it.
Art Manager: Of course. Take your time, Master Zhezhi. Let me know when you've decided.
Zhezhi: Ha... I need a walk. Maybe I'll find some new inspiration.
(Enter the gateway)
Zhezhi: This place...
Zhezhi: It's all so beautiful... I have to capture it.
(Head to the designated location)
Zhezhi: the landscape looks great from this side. It's perfect for planning my painting.
Zhezhi: Waters and mountains rest by the pane, valleys and peaks in the dream remain...
Zhezhi: The composition looks fine, but something's still missing...
Zhezhi: Maybe I should get closer to see the tiny details of the trees and rocks
(Cutscene plays)
(Cutscene ends)
Zhezhi: That place should be close enough.
Zhezhi: Waterlamp, Dewvetch, Pearl Leaf, and Bittberry
Zhezhi: These vibrant plans harmonize exquisitely with the cold stones.
(Talk to strange white cat)
Strange White Cat: Meow-
(Head to the designated location)
Zhezhi: Didn't expect to see Tacet Discords like that here.
Zhezhi: Hmm... They do complete the scene I had in mind.
(After defeat Tacet Discords)
Zhezhi: The details of the stones and trees... I got it.
Zhezhi: I can show this draft to my manager.
(Return to speak with your manager)
Art Manager: Master Zhezhi!
I-I'm no master...
Please, just call me Zhezhi.
Art Manager: Okay, Master Zhezhi! About the painting I mentioned last time...
Here's the draft.
Art Manager: Very well! Let's see!
(Give the draft)
Art Manager: ...
Art Manager: What? What's this?
I had new inspiration.
It's still a draft, but...
Art Manager: Zhezhi, you're a true master! Would a master present a client with a half-finished piece?
Art Manager: Your last painting sold for the highest price at auction! Give the people what they want, that's what I always say.
Art Manager: You just need to paint it again, and I'll make sure it sells well.
Paint it... again?
Art Manager: With all due respect, Master Zhezhi, not everyone will buy whatever you paint.
Art Manager: I've worked so hard to find a few clients who love your style. How can I sell your paintings if you can't cater to their needs?
Art Manager: Please focus on recre—I mean, creating tonight! I won't disturb you. I'll come and pick it up tomorrow.
Art Manager: No more indulging your every creative whim. All I'm asking for is another Winter's Serenade in Bloom. I'm counting on you, Master Zhezhi!
Zhezhi: I have to make another copy...
(Start painting)
Zhezhi: ...
Zhezhi quickly completes yet another copy of the Winter's Serenade in Bloom. However, her manager soon requests another one.
(Start painting again)
Zhezhi: ...
Zhezhi loses track of how many times she recreates the same painting, the stack of scrolls growing ever taller.
(Paint...?)
Zhezhi: ...
Perhaps I'm nothing more than a tool for copying paintings.
Zhezhi: Can I really call myself an artist then?
Zhezhi: In their eyes... am I only capable of copying my old work?
(Resist the nightmares)
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): Zhezhi.
(Stop the nightmares from corrupting Zhezhi)
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): What do you really want to paint?
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): Do you remember when you painted the first Winter's Serenade in Bloom?
Zhezhi: Yes. I saw flowers blooming in the middle of winter, and birds were circling around...
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): You worked really hard on it.
Zhezhi: And... that hard work should be noticed.
(Confront the nightmares)
(‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍): Believe in your judgment, your brush, and yourself.
Zhezhi: Believe in... myself.
(Defeat the nightmares)
(Zhezhi musters her courage and continues to work on the unfinished draft.)
Zhezhi: Waters and mountains rest by the pane, valleys and peaks in the dream remain. Colors of vanity washed away, the painted world fades, forgotten today...
(Impermanence Heron: Death Incarnate appears)
Zhezhi: This giant bird... It's... it's the one from Winter's Serenade in Bloom!
Art Manager: I keep telling you, your clients only want that one painting!
Art Manager: Don't be so stubborn, Zhezhi! A painting that doesn't sell well is meaningless!
Zhezhi: I'm the artist, not just the brush.
Zhezhi: It's the soul I put into my paintings that makes people appreciate them!
(After defeating the Impermanence Heron)
Zhezhi: Thank you, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)..
(Leave the Somnoire)
(Quest returns to When the Night Knocks)
